Title: Developer Feature: DeveloperLayoutComponent
Summary: Two-column sidebar layout for developer documentation pages. Provides sticky sidebar navigation with toggle support for mobile.
Content:
## DeveloperLayoutComponent

**File:** `src/app/features/developer/components/developer-layout/developer-layout.component.ts`

**Selector:** `app-developer-layout`

**Standalone:** Yes

**Imports:** `RouterOutlet`, `RouterLink`, `RouterLinkActive`

**Change Detection:** `OnPush`

### State (Signals)

| Signal | Type | Initial | Description |
|--------|------|---------|-------------|
| `sidebarOpen` | `boolean` | `true` | Controls sidebar visibility |
| `devPages` | `DocPage[]` | `[{id:'extension-development',...}]` | Sidebar navigation items |

### Methods

| Method | Returns | Description |
|--------|---------|-------------|
| `toggleSidebar()` | `void` | Toggles `sidebarOpen` signal |

### Sidebar Navigation Items

Currently contains one entry:
- **Extension Development** → `/developer/extensions` (icon: `bi-puzzle`)

### CSS Classes

- `.dev-layout` — root flex container
- `.dev-sidebar` — sticky sidebar (260px wide, collapsible on mobile)
- `.dev-sidebar.collapsed` — hidden on mobile, visible on lg+
- `.dev-content` — main content area with `flex-grow-1`

### Template Structure

```
dev-layout (d-flex)
├── nav.dev-sidebar (bg-light border-end)
│   ├── h5: "Developer Docs"
│   ├── toggle button (mobile only)
│   └── ul.nav-pills (renders devPages)
└── main.dev-content
    ├── toggle button (mobile only)
    └── router-outlet
```

### Architecture Notes

- Mirrors `DocLayoutComponent` but scoped to developer docs
- Sidebar is sticky at `top: 56px` (navbar height)
- Mobile: sidebar hidden by default, toggle button visible
- Desktop (lg+): sidebar always visible, toggle button hidden
- Uses `DocPage` model from global `src/app/models/doc-pagemodel.model.ts`
